//TextBrowserRedirect: Which user agents are sent to the /t text pages, and whether to send them at all. Semicolon-separated, matched as case-insensitive substrings. The <noscript> block in index.html covers everyone else.
//TelegramBot: Bot for group chats. PublicBaseUrl is where this installation is reachable from outside (https for webhooks and for the mini app); leave empty and the bot will not offer links. Enabled is the on/off switch and leaves the rest of the settings alone. Mode: off | polling (local, needs no public address) | webhook (production, requires TelegramBot_WebhookSecret). AllowedChats empty = any chat.
